version: aderyn 0.6.8 (built from the v0.6.8 source release with the local Windows portability patch reports/aderyn-windows.patch)

triage.title: ETH transferred without address checks
triage.reason: refund() moves no ETH; it returns the escrowed ERC-20 to the payer recorded at creation (never to msg.sender), only after refundAfter and once (Held -> Refunded, nonReentrant).

triage.title: ETH transferred without address checks
triage.reason: depositLiquidity() moves no ETH; it pulls the caller's own ERC-20 and credits the caller's liquidity.

triage.title: ETH transferred without address checks
triage.reason: withdrawLiquidity() moves no ETH; it pays ERC-20 only to msg.sender, bounded by msg.sender's own credited liquidity (checked subtraction reverts first).

triage.title: Reentrancy: State change after external call
triage.reason: IPayeeBookView.lookup is declared view, so it is a STATICCALL: the callee cannot change state or re-enter a state-changing path; the spent counter is keyed by msg.sender (the DelegationManager).

lowNote: Aderyn has no Medium level; Low findings are counted, not triaged.
